historical_holdout_reason: The existing 2026 historical interval was already designated/accessed by prior research, and local ignored artifacts and access history cannot establish non-exposure.
attestation_scope: No agent, prior prompt, local gptpro artifact, ignored run, or manual research exposed holdout event-level data before release.
Formula, timing, instrument identity, source route, family membership, sample plan, and gates were frozen before holdout sealing.
The custodian and operator are distinct people and each signature covers the exact manifest, custody-contract, data-root, and access-log hashes.
Any unknown access history is reported as contamination, not assumed clean.

release_policy.release_authority: independent custodian after PRE_RUN_OK signed by operator and reviewer

invalid_if: release_count is not zero at seal or one at release
storage is mutable or custody is not independent
operator, custodian, and reviewer identities are not all distinct
formula, family, source, runner, or gate changed after seal

integrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators; omit integrity.artifact_sha256 before hashing
